table.retrieve:
SELECT  servicerheader.servicerinvcode , 
	servicerheader.serviceinvcode ,
	servicerheader.servicercatcode , 
	servicerheader.date , 
	servicerheader.remarks , 
	AliasName=(SELECT A.AliasName FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=servicerheader.custcode),
	servicerheader.custcode , 
	servicerheader.salesmancode , 
	servicerheader.discperc , 
	servicerheader.flatdisc , 
	servicerheader.misccharges , 
	servicerheader.posted , 
	servicerheader.postdate , 
	serviceheader.date , 
	users.username,
	doctors.name,
	serviceheader.doctcode,
	servicerheader.originaldate,
	servicerheader.modifiedby,
	servicerheader.postedby,		
	servicerheader.headerno,
	servicerheader.headerinvno,
	patientregno=space(50),
	servicerheader.patientcode,
	servicerheader.admissioncode,
	GuestRegNo=(SELECT G.RegNo FROM Guest G WHERE G.GuestCode=servicerheader.GuestCode),
	servicerheader.GuestCode,
	servicerheader.GuestCheckInCode,
	StudentRegNo=(SELECT ST.RegNo FROM Student ST WHERE ST.StudentCode=servicerheader.StudentCode),
	servicerheader.StudentCode,
	ChasisNo=(SELECT MV.ChasisNo FROM MotorVehicle MV WHERE MV.MotorVehicleCode=servicerheader.MotorVehicleCode),
	servicerheader.MotorVehicleCode,
	servicerheader.ServiceInvGstPerc,
	servicerheader.CashAccCode,
	servicerheader.CashTendered,
	servicerheader.CashCharged,
	servicerheader.CashBack,
	invtotal = servicerheader.invtotal,
	servicerheader.OutstandingAmt,
	servicerheader.CashierShiftCode
FROM  
		serviceheader LEFT OUTER JOIN Doctors ON (serviceheader.doctcode = doctors.doctcode), 
		users ,   
		servicerheader
WHERE 
	( dbo.servicerheader.servicerinvcode = :ra_saleretinvcode )  and
	( users.usercode = servicerheader.salesmancode ) and 
	( servicerheader.serviceinvcode = serviceheader.serviceinvcode )
